items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, last year Professor Manetta and I went to see him in California.

ctx.x: He'd come tell me he was asking for me, but I didn't know nothing until he was gone back. Well, he lives way down the Ninth Ward. Yeah. Flood Street. Yeah, no way. But I mean he was gone when I found out he was asking for me. Nobody didn't tell him how to get in touch with me.
Well, last year Professor Manetta and I went to see him in California. Yeah, California. He went to his home out there. He's big and fat yet they told me.
